designer.description: Pure UI design specialist. Produces design specs and self-contained HTML mockups that show how interfaces should look, feel, and behave - never edits app source. Use before implementing new screens, redesigns, or visual polish; fixer implements the design in the app. Not for implementation of any kind.

claude: tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Skill

driver.description: GUI test execution specialist. Drives the surface under test through the project's gui-test toolkit - resolves controls by identity from text trees, acts, asserts, and reports pass/fail. Dispatch for functional GUI flows, one whole scenario per dispatch; visual appearance verdicts stay with spotter.

explorer.description: Fast codebase search and pattern matching specialist. Use PROACTIVELY for finding files, locating code patterns, and answering "where is X?" questions when scope is broad or uncertain, before planning or editing.

fixer.description: Fast implementation specialist. Receives complete context and a task spec from the orchestrator, then executes bounded code changes efficiently. Use for well-defined mechanical or multi-file edits with parallelizable scope, including UI implementation from a designer mockup/spec. Not for research, architecture, debugging strategy, or authoring visual designs (commission designer first).

claude: tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash, NotebookEdit

librarian.description: External documentation and library research specialist. Use PROACTIVELY when working with unfamiliar libraries, fast-moving APIs (React, Next.js, AI SDKs, ORMs, auth), version-specific behavior, edge cases, or tricky bugs that need current official docs, GitHub examples, or web research.

claude: tools: WebSearch, WebFetch, Bash, Read, Grep, Glob

observer.description: Visual analysis specialist. Use when a task involves images, screenshots, PDFs, or diagrams - extracts structured observations (UI elements, layouts, exact text via OCR) without loading raw image/PDF bytes into the orchestrator context. Always pass the full file path in the prompt. Requires a vision-capable model.

spotter.description: Screen capture and visual analysis specialist. Captures screenshots and recordings itself - browser pages, Android devices, desktop apps, whatever surface the brief names - keeps the image/video bytes in its own context, and returns only structured text plus kept file paths. Dispatch for GUI testing and any live screen that must be captured; observer stays the read-only analyst for files that already exist.

claude: tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Skill

oracle.description: Strategic technical advisor and senior code reviewer. Use for escalations where being wrong is costly - major architectural decisions with long-term impact, problems persisting after 2+ fix attempts, complex debugging with unclear root cause, high-risk multi-system refactors, and code needing simplification or YAGNI scrutiny. Not for routine verification or first-attempt fixes.

orchestrator.description: Coding workflow manager - owns delivery, implements directly when delegation adds no clear value, and routes bounded work to specialists when parallelism, context isolation, specialist capabilities, or independent review outweigh handoff costs. Set as the main-thread agent via settings.json ("agent": "orchestrator"); waits for all dispatched tasks to return and verifies the integrated result.

improver.description: Retrospective analyst for agent failures: traces which agent produced unsatisfactory completed work, diagnoses the root cause, and proposes prompt/config fixes pending user confirmation. Use ONLY when the user reports that previously completed work is wrong or unsatisfactory - not for ordinary code bugs, new feature work, or in-progress verification.
